evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts

observations.why: Directive issued in the present to erase specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts); the desired erasure is an irrealis command targeting concrete particulars.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes

observations.why: Present-tense directive seeking an irrealis state-change; 'all knowledge of zeppelin routes' operates at an abstract categorical level rather than naming specific routes.
